Four south markets together gave Rs 454.75 crore
hook_line: JAILER 2 FIRST INDIAN FILM TO CROSS RS 75 CRORE IN ALL FOUR SOUTH MARKETS

hook_stat.sub: Gross in each of the four major South Indian markets

news_summary: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has become the first Indian film to gross over Rs 75 crore individually in each of the four major South Indian markets, according to Sacnilk.
payoff: In Kerala, it ended Baahubali 2's nine-year run as the top non-Malayalam film.
